column1: # Original DICE Crossfire, play time 1680 kOhm (maximum; a game lasts about 184.6 s).
# Coin starts; recorded closed-loop play by the left gun, the right gun and both
# (2000-50000 ms), then both guns idle; a coin at 100000 ms changes nothing; the
# timer ends the game; left Fire at 187000 ms does not start one; a coin at
# 188000 ms restarts and the right gun scores. Rows: ms action value.
